# Turnpo

Turnpo is a personal story and AI work profile platform for the AI era.

Public pages:
- https://www.turnpo.com/
- https://www.turnpo.com/u/leo
- https://www.turnpo.com/u/cindy
- https://www.turnpo.com/u/demo-friend

Principles:
- Human-readable profiles. AI-readable context.
- Published profile content is intended to be readable by people and AI tools.
- Unpublished source material, owner drafts, and deleted content must not be included in public AI-readable context.

Reliable fallback:
- Use each profile's "Copy AI Profile" button to copy published-approved Markdown context.
